Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not put my full name on this, if that's okay. You already have it on the claim.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Sugar Land, Texas. I'd just pulled into a spot near the main entrance.
Q: Were you moving or parked when the other vehicle made contact?
A: I was backing out of the space, going slowly, maybe five miles an hour. The other car came down the aisle and
clipped the rear quarter panel of mine.
Q: Did either of you see the other vehicle before impact?
A: I didn't. I was checking my mirror on the driver's side. I only heard a bang and felt the car jolt.
Q: How fast do you think the other vehicle was traveling?
A: Not very fast, it was a parking lot. It felt like a light tap, but enough to push my head forward and back.
Q: Did you get out and speak with the other driver?
A: Yes, briefly. We exchanged insurance details. The other driver said she was sorry and that she hadn't seen me.
Q: Have you noticed any injuries since the collision?
A: My neck has been stiff and sore, mostly in the mornings. I have some tightness in the shoulders too. I've been
using heat packs and taking over-the-counter pain relievers.
Q: Have you sought medical attention?
A: I went to urgent care the same week. They said it looked like a neck strain and gave me a few instructions and
some exercises to do at home.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I want to get my car repaierd and get back to normal. I'm still having some trouble turning my head to the
left, but I'm trying to keep up with the exercises.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>
